anomalies.observed: R7 is 10 Ω and connects DISP_SDA to VCC.
anomalies.expected: R7 should be a 10 kΩ pull-up from DISP_SDA to VCC, as specified.

evidence.quote: `DISP_SDA`: U2 pin 35 (`PB14`) — R7 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U4 pins 19/20 (`D1`/`D2`)

anomalies.impact: The display SDA line is pulled strongly toward VCC instead of through a normal pull-up. This can prevent the MCU from pulling the line low reliably and may cause excessive current when it does.

parsed.summary: R7 is specified as a 10 kΩ display SDA pull-up, but the netlist gives it as 10 Ω. This substantially over-strength pull-up can impair or prevent display I2C communication.
